claim: Hello Partner's July 2025 article is a truncated/paywalled recirculation of the Billion Dollar Boy burnout survey, confirming only the headline set (n=1,000 creators + 1,000 marketers, US/UK, 52% burnout, 37% quit consideration) before the content is paywalled.
scope_conditions: Derivative, not independent; does not name Censuswide as fielding agency. Included in this batch only to document breadth of recirculation, not as an independent data point. US/UK only.
quoted_support: "The study, which surveyed 1,000 creators and 1,000 senior marketers across the US and UK, found that more than half (52%) of creators have experienced burnout as a direct result of their work, with almost two in five (37%) considering quitting the industry altogether."
